Definition: from G1909 and G75; to struggle for:--earnestly contend for.
BiblicalUsage: Jude says it was needful to write and exhort the saints to earnestly contend for the faith once delivered in Jude 1:3 — to struggle for it, as an athlete struggles for the prize.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the faith was delivered once, and my job is not to improve it but to contend for it, earnestly and without apology.
